name: matchwork
description: 火柴等式 Matchwork — 浏览器原生火柴棒算术. 每关最少搬数由合法版面图上的完整 BFS 量出, 关卡在构建期生成并复验.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js server.cjs electron/main.cjs tools/*.mjs test/*.mjs; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && echo OK
scripts.unit: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do echo ":: $f"; node "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run unit

author: z-biz-game
